title: Templates editor: choose the structure
question: Same look as the app (navy shell, Action Blue, Inter and Bricolage). Three ways to organise one editor for agreement and contract wording, a page you click on instead of a form. Pick one, steer it, or re-roll.

options.label: Sections list + page
options.thesis: A short list of the document's sections sits beside the page: switch each on or off, drag to reorder, click one to edit it in place.
materials: white page on cool grey ground
options.viewport: Slim icon rail, a 280px Sections list (Cover and intro, Service included, Price lines locked, Visit schedule, Equipment list off, Terms, Signatures locked) and the page beside it with the selected section outlined and a small toolbar on it.
options.risk: The list and the page both show structure, so on a phone it must collapse to one of them.

options.label: Page + floating dock
options.lineage: Canvas editors with a bottom tool dock
options.thesis: Nothing but the page: a floating dock at the bottom adds anything, and the page gets the whole screen.
options.viewport: A wide page centred on the grey ground, one block selected with a mini toolbar, and a dark pill dock floating at the bottom: Heading, Text, Clauses, Divider, then Price, Schedule, Equipment, Signature and a Fields chip menu.
options.risk: Least discoverable for a first-time owner, and a floating dock can cover the page's last lines on a short screen.

options.label: Add Element panel + page
options.lineage: Jotform PDF editor, the reference you sent
options.thesis: A short Add Element panel on the left, the page in the middle: click an element and it lands on the page.
options.viewport: A dark Add Element panel with two groups (Writing: Heading, Text, Clauses, Divider, Page break; Document parts: Service included, Price lines, Visit schedule, Equipment list, Signatures) and the page beside it, one block selected, plus a field chips row below.
options.risk: Document parts can only appear once, so the panel must show them as used instead of letting a second one be added.
